title: Clasping folds enable superior elastic strength of graphene films
title_zh: 可折叠的折痕使石墨烯薄膜具有卓越的弹性强度
abstract: Two-dimensional graphene sheets show strong potential for use in fabrication of macroscopic films, as they have exceptional mechanical properties owing to their in-plane strength1-6. Improvements in the stacking order of flat two-dimensional sheets have led to corresponding improvements in the strength and toughness of such films7-11. In addition, modulation of the spatial conformation of individual units has enabled the development of benchmark materials with superior properties12,13; however, this has remained elusive in the case of two-dimensional sheets. Here we report a strategy for preparation of graphene films with a combination of high strength (2.9 GPa), toughness (84.5 MJ m-3) and elastic strain (5%). We attribute these performance gains to a fold-clasping lamellar structure achieved by modular assembly of surface-folded multilayer graphene oxide flakes. We identify a pull-to-push transition of force chain topology and propose a shear-lock stress transfer strategy in the fold-clasping lamellar graphene film that enables advances in mechanical properties. This work demonstrates the modular design of spatial conformation of two-dimensional flakes on a large scale and further improves the performance of macroscopic films for potential applications in lightweight structural components.
abstract_zh: 二维石墨烯片在制备宏观薄膜方面显示出强大的潜力，因为它们具有卓越的力学性能，这归因于其内向强度1-6。二维片的堆叠顺序改进导致此类薄膜的强度和韧性相应提升7-11。此外，单个单元空间构象的调控使得具有优异性能的基准材料得以开发12,13；然而，在二维片的情况下，这仍然是一个难以企及的目标。在此，我们报告了一种制备具有高强度（2.9 GPa）、高韧性（84.5 MJ m-3）和高弹性应变（5%）的石墨烯薄膜的策略。我们将这些性能提升归因于通过模块化组装表面折叠的多层石墨烯氧化物片而实现的折痕夹层结构。我们识别出力链拓扑的从拉向推的转变，并提出了折痕夹层石墨烯薄膜中的剪切锁定应力转移策略，这使得力学性能取得了进展。这项工作展示了二维片在大规模上空间构象的模块化设计，并进一步提高了宏观薄膜的性能，适用于轻量化结构部件的潜在应用。
